Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

The floor starts to go. You run with it for one last stride, reaching for the companion beside you.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
Agility
Target / range / shape
Self when a floor, ledge or support gives way beneath you.
Type
Skill / Movement / Defense

Before the fall, make an Agility roll and move across the collapsing support without provoking.

Weak
Move up to 2 squares.
Standard
Move up to 3 squares.
Strong
Move up to 4 squares and carry one adjacent willing or unconscious companion you can physically support.

End on a free supported square or resolve the remaining fall from your new position.
